title: A Difficult Year of Sorrow
paragraphs: Selama masa yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Tahun Duka Cita, Nabi ﷺ kehilangan istri tercintanya Khadijah dan pamannya Abu Thalib dalam waktu yang berdekatan, dua orang yang telah melindungi dan mendukungnya selama bertahun-tahun. Sambil menghadapi duka pribadi ini, ia juga sedang menghadapi permusuhan yang semakin meningkat dari orang-orang di Makkah, yang merasa lebih berani setelah perlindungan pamannya tidak lagi berdiri di antara mereka dan dirinya.

Meski menanggung beban kehilangan dua pendukung terdekatnya sekaligus menghadapi tekanan dari luar, ia melanjutkan misinya tanpa berhenti, percaya bahwa kesulitan pada akhirnya akan diikuti dengan kelapangan. Masa ini sering dipelajari saat ini sebagai contoh menanggung duka dan kesulitan secara bersamaan, menunjukkan bahwa ketangguhan bukan berarti tidak merasakan apa-apa, melainkan tetap melangkah maju meski merasakan segalanya.
answerKey: During what later became known as the Year of Sorrow, the Prophet ﷺ lost both his beloved wife Khadijah and his uncle Abu Talib within a short period, two people who had protected and supported him for years. While facing this personal grief, he was also dealing with growing hostility from people in Makkah, who felt emboldened once his uncle's protection was no longer standing between them and him. Despite the weight of losing two closest supporters while simultaneously facing outside pressure, he continued his mission without pausing, trusting that difficulty would eventually be followed by relief. This period is often studied today as an example of enduring grief and hardship simultaneously, showing that resilience does not mean feeling nothing, but continuing forward despite feeling everything.
